page.content:
Jade Emperor's court that Wukong wrecks and later must serve.

How Heaven connects

  • Character: Jade Emperor — The Jade Emperor sits at the head of Heaven's bureaucracy.
  • Event: Revolt against Heaven — The revolt is fought through the halls of Heaven.

What is Heaven?

The celestial court — halls, peach garden, and stables — is the bureaucracy Wukong first joins as Protector of the Horses and then smashes as Great Sage Equal to Heaven.

Key threads lead to Jade Emperor and Revolt against Heaven.
